summary: New and updated tests strengthen media correctness around color metadata, AV1 snapshots, and AudioWorklet behavior. Test videos with explicit transfer functions (color transfer curves) and AV1 color-quad tolerances were added so color handling regressions are caught; a media-gpu mochitest ensures GPU-related rendering remains sane. There’s also a targeted change ensuring the AudioWorklet message port closes cleanly on the main thread, preventing teardown races.
